baseline: All production source/meta files match the immediate pre-refactor hash manifest; test files excluded from both measurement projects.
protocolRevision: Windowed trials rejected for focus failure before any valid capture; both profiles now use the same offscreen/drained scope and require at least 99% positive CPU frame timings.
runtimeMemoryScope: /usr/bin/time -l native Player lifetime maximum RSS; same capture harness in both versions; last paired run includes PNG capture before sampling.
bakeTimeScope: Core calculation and fresh batch save, plus separately timed public initial bake and overwrite/rebuild with scene output; input construction and process startup excluded.
bakeMemoryScope: Exact OS process peak covers startup, fixture construction, core/save, public initial/rebuild and cleanup; phase RSS is sampled at about 10 ms.
